title: Curse of Canaan
author: Eustace Mullins
description: Curse of Canaan: A Demonology of History by Eustace Mullins (Revelation Books, 1987). Mullins, an American writer associated with far-right and antisemitic politics, offers a conspiratorial reading of world history in which the biblical curse on Canaan (Genesis 9) becomes the origin of a hidden lineage and a demonic, satanic tradition held to have shaped events from antiquity through the Babylonian and Phoenician cults to secret societies, Freemasonry, international banking, wars and modern revolutions. The book is widely regarded as antisemitic conspiracy literature, and its historical claims are not supported by scholarship. It is catalogued under Other as a document of twentieth-century conspiracy and 'demonology of history' writing rather than as a reliable source.
